#705 · Soft Tissue Pokémon

Sliggoo

Dragon

Kalos · Generation 6

Sliggoo is a Dragon-type Soft Tissue Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 17.5 kg. It evolves from Goomy and into Goodra. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (113), with a base stat total of 452.
